jobs.title: Vice President of Technology and Data
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Vice President, Technology & Data will build the technology and data foundation Equiton needs to operate with greater confidence, efficiency and insight. The VP will assess Equiton’s current systems and capabilities, set a clear direction for improvement, and lead the work to create a more integrated, reliable and well-governed environment.

This is a player-coach role with broad impact across Equiton’s businesses. The VP will modernize core systems, centralize ownership of business applications, build an enterprise data warehouse and reporting capability, and advance practical uses of AI and automation, working with leaders across the organization to prioritize initiatives and deliver measurable results.

***Please note this is an in-office position based in Burlington, ON.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and Priorities

Assess Equiton’s technology environment, including systems, infrastructure, data, vendors, team capabilities and risks, and translate business priorities into a phased technology roadmap.
Define Equiton’s technology architecture and standards, building on our existing Microsoft environment and introducing new platforms where there is a clear business case.
Own the technology budget and build business cases for major investments, setting clear outcomes and tracking delivery, adoption, costs and benefits.

Systems and Delivery

Lead the modernization and integration of Equiton’s enterprise systems, including the transition to HubSpot CRM and the selection and implementation of accounting, property management and construction management platforms.
Guide projects from requirements through testing and launch, improving reliability, performance and adoption.
Take central ownership of all business applications and SaaS: maintain the inventory, approve new purchases, decide what to build, buy, improve or retire, and manage vendors, contracts, licensing, renewals, access and spend, with defined stakeholders and administrators for each application.

Data and AI

Lead the design and development of an enterprise data warehouse that brings Equiton’s core systems together in a reliable source of truth, with clear data ownership and quality standards.
Build reporting and analytics, including Power BI dashboards and self-service reporting, that give leaders timely insight into fund, portfolio, investor and operational performance.
Develop an enterprise approach to AI and automation, leading practical initiatives that improve productivity and decision-making, with appropriate safeguards for data protection, security and human oversight.

Governance and Team Leadership

Serve as Equiton’s senior information security leader, accountable for the cybersecurity program, including security policies, identity and access management, endpoint and vulnerability management, third-party risk, security awareness training and cyber-risk reporting to the CEO and leadership team.
Establish governance for technology, applications, data and vendors that supports applicable Canadian and U.S. requirements, and oversee incident response, disaster recovery and business continuity.
Lead and develop Equiton’s technology team, including internal development, data and reporting, and desktop support.
Partner with leaders across Equiton to understand business needs, drive adoption and deliver practical results.

What You’ll Bring

12+ years of progressive technology experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role setting strategy and leading the modernization of an existing environment, including enterprise system implementations (accounting, property management or construction management platforms especially relevant).
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Management, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
Deep experience with the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Power Platform) is required; experience leading a CRM migration (HubSpot preferred) or with AWS is an asset.
Strong, hands-on data background, including data architecture, warehousing, integrations, governance and BI, and a track record of delivering practical AI and automation initiatives.
Experience leading development, data and analytics teams or external partners, and managing a business application portfolio, vendors and technology spend.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity and IT risk frameworks (such as NIST or CIS), with experience leading security, privacy and business continuity programs.
Experience in a regulated, complex or multi-business environment; real estate, private equity, asset management, multinational or U.S. market experience is an asset.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions in business terms.

About Us

Founded in 2015, Equiton is one of Canada’s fastest-growing private equity firms, helping Canadians build wealth through high-quality real estate investments. Our mission is to make private real estate accessible to more Canadians, and our team is the driving force behind our success.

Follow us on LinkedIn
Visit our Website
Explore #LifeAtEquiton

Why Equiton?

Our culture is built on integrity, accountability, and innovation. We empower our team to take initiative, think independently, and grow personally and professionally. To learn more about our core values, click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. If you need accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We’re happy to help.

Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please note that at present, legal eligibility to work in Canada is a prerequisite for this role.

Artificial Intelligence

As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support activities such as resume screening, interview scheduling, note-taking, and candidate evaluation. AI-assisted tools are used to help improve efficiency and consistency; however, all hiring decisions are made by qualified members of our hiring team. We are committed to ensuring a fair, inclusive, and human-centered recruitment process.

You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

Job Description:

Director, Enterprise Architecture Strategy, Core Platform

The Director, Enterprise Architecture Strategy is the architecture strategist supporting the Assistant Vice President, Enterprise Architecture, Core Platforms.

The Director drives the architecture integration strategy across cloud, on premise, network, application platforms, and foundational technology services. The role translates enterprise and business priorities into actionable architecture direction, roadmaps, investment priorities, standards, and modernization outcomes.

Working closely with the AVP, other Enterprise Architects, technology executives, engineering leaders, and domain and solution architects, the Director ensures that architecture priorities are aligned with business, operational, security, regulatory, and cost outcomes.

What will you do?

Working in collaboration with the other Enterprise Architects, define future-state architectures, transition roadmaps, principles, standards, reference architectures, and decision boundaries.
Provide strategic analysis, recommendations, visibility and executive reporting into architecture decisions, investments, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
Maintain an integrated view of architecture priorities, decisions, dependencies, and outcomes.
Translate business priorities, executive direction, regulatory obligations, operational risks, and technology constraints into actionable architecture priorities.
Integrate cloud, infrastructure, network, security, identity, platform, API, and application architecture into a coherent enterprise direction.
Facilitate joint architecture planning and decision-making where initiatives cross business, portfolio, or technology boundaries.
Promote the reuse of enterprise capabilities, platforms, standards, patterns, and architecture decisions.
Escalate unresolved cross-domain decisions to the appropriate architecture or executive authority.
Lead architecture governance and ensure architecture decisions are documented, traceable, implementable, and aligned with security, resilience, operational, financial, and compliance requirements.
Partner with engineering and operational leaders to validate that architecture direction is practical, financially responsible, and sustainable in production.
Define and communicate measurable outcomes for technology health, risk reduction, resilience, cost efficiency, simplification and platform adoption.

What you'll need to succeed?

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology Management, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is preferred.
Enterprise architecture credentials such as TOGAF, IASA CITA, or an equivalent architecture certification are preferred.
10 or more years of progressive architecture experience, including enterprise, portfolio, or cross-domain responsibility.
Demonstrated experience developing enterprise technology strategies, future-state architectures, integrated roadmaps, standards, and transition plans.
Broad knowledge of cloud platforms, networks, operating systems, middleware, identity, security, virtualization, application hosting, APIs, integration, automation, and platform engineering.
Experience with cloud migration, infrastructure transformation, vulnerability remediation, technology currency, lifecycle management, and technical debt reduction.
Experience integrating architecture strategies and resolving dependencies across multiple business and technology domains.
Proven ability to influence senior business and technology leaders through clear analysis, options, trade-offs, and recommendations.
Ability to translate business and enterprise priorities into actionable architecture direction.
Ability to synthesize complex and fragmented information into a coherent enterprise position.
Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and influence.
Strong financial and analytical acumen, including investment, cost, risk, and value trade-offs.
Ability to lead through influence, establish decision clarity, and resolve conflicts.
Sound judgment regarding when to standardize, consolidate, modernize, remediate, replace, retire, or accept risk.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days per year.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.
Working together, sharing common values, and encouraging growth & achievement.

As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only as the position includes managing both French and English-speaking staff (Quebec and outside Quebec) and providing daily support to the team.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Job Description:

Director, Domain Enterprise Architect, Technology Modernization and Cloudification

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President, Enterprise Architecture, Core Platforms
, the Director, Domain Enterprise Architect, Technology Modernization and Cloudification leads the architecture for modernizing and migrating Sun Life’s on-premises technology estate to the cloud.

The Director defines the domain strategy, future-state architecture, standards, reference architectures, and transition roadmaps. The scope includes OpenShift, virtualization, servers, operating systems, databases, storage technologies, and related infrastructure services.

Working with Technology Executives, other Enterprise Architects, engineering leaders, cybersecurity, cloud engineering, AI platform teams, and application development, the Director aligns cloud migration with enterprise priorities, regulatory obligations, operational requirements, and cost outcomes. The role also leads AI-enabled automation projects that accelerate modernization.

What will you do?

Lead AI-enabled automation projects that accelerate technology discovery, estate analysis, dependency mapping, migration planning, remediation, testing, and architecture documentation.
Define and maintain the domain architecture strategy, future-state architectures, principles, standards, reference architectures, and decision boundaries.
Develop and maintain an integrated roadmap for migrating on-premises container, virtualization, server, operating system, database, storage, and related infrastructure technologies to cloud services.
Maintain architecture documentation covering the existing technology estate, target cloud architectures, transition plans, dependencies, architecture decisions, lifecycle risks, technical debt, and retirement plans.
Collaborate with Technology Executives to communicate architecture direction, options, trade-offs, dependencies, investment considerations, risks, and modernization outcomes, and align cloud migration roadmaps with enterprise and operational priorities.
Assess the current-state technology estate to identify cloud migration opportunities, unsupported technologies, security vulnerabilities, platform fragmentation, technical debt, lifecycle exposure, resilience gaps, and operational risks.
Define target cloud architectures, workload placement direction, transition states, migration sequencing, dependencies, and retirement plans that support the progressive reduction of the on-premises technology estate.
Establish architecture patterns and decision frameworks for rehosting, re-platforming, refactoring, consolidating, containerizing, replacing, retiring, or temporarily retaining technologies.
Provide subject-matter expertise and architectural leadership across cloud infrastructure and platform services, Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, virtualization, servers, operating systems, enterprise databases, storage technologies, and related infrastructure services.
Identify barriers to cloud migration and define the application, data, security, privacy, network, identity, integration, operational, and platform changes required to address them.
Evaluate relevant cloud capabilities, managed services, and vendor offerings to inform future-state architecture, technology standards, migration approaches, and investment recommendations, and collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Business Group Architects, Solution Architects, and engineering leaders to align migration decisions and cross-domain dependencies.
Lead domain architecture governance and ensure architecture decisions are traceable, implementable, and aligned with security, resilience, operational, financial, regulatory, and compliance requirements.

What you'll need to succeed?

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is preferred.
Enterprise architecture credentials such as TOGAF, IASA CITA, or an equivalent architecture certification are preferred.
Advanced cloud architecture certification is strongly preferred.
Relevant infrastructure, container, database, virtualization, storage, networking, automation, or security certifications are considered assets.
10 or more years of progressive architecture experience, including enterprise, domain, cloud, infrastructure, platform, or cross-technology responsibility.
Extensive experience designing enterprise cloud architectures and leading the architectural migration of large-scale on-premises technology estates to cloud infrastructure, managed services, and cloud-native capabilities.
Demonstrated experience defining cloud strategies, future-state architectures, transition roadmaps, workload placement direction, architecture standards, modernization patterns, and technology retirement plans.
Broad architecture experience across cloud services, Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, virtualization, servers, operating systems, enterprise databases, storage, networking, identity, security, resilience, observability, and automation.
Proven ability to collaborate with Technology Executives and influence senior technology leaders through clear analysis, architecture options, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations.
Excellent mastery of cloud architecture, managed platform services, cloud-native patterns, migration architectures, hybrid transition states, and enterprise cloud operating considerations.
Ability to translate enterprise priorities, executive direction, regulatory obligations, operational risks, and technology constraints into actionable modernization and cloudification direction.
Ability to assess complex technology estates and determine the appropriate cloud destination, service model, migration approach, sequencing, transition architecture, and retirement path.
Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and influence, with the ability to provide implementable architecture direction without assuming engineering, delivery, or operational ownership.
A clear and actionable Technology Modernization and Cloudification strategy and roadmap covering on-premises containers, virtualization, servers, operating systems, databases, storage technologies, and their target cloud services.
Measurable migration of on-premises technologies and workloads to approved cloud services, supported by defined target architectures, transition states, migration sequencing, and retirement plans.
Measurable acceleration and reduced manual effort in technology discovery, migration planning, remediation, and documentation through AI-enabled automation.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days per year.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.
Working together, sharing common values, and encouraging growth & achievement.

As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only as the position includes managing both French and English-speaking staff (Quebec and outside Quebec) and providing daily support to the team.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

As an Associate Director, you will lead the delivery of client engagements, serving as the day-to-day point of contact for the client, guiding a team of consultants through the project lifecycle, and ensuring that high quality projects are consistently executed on time and on budget. While developing your project and people management skills, you will further augment your advisory toolkit by digging deep into client problems in real-time and delivering ongoing thought partnership. With business leaders to guide you along the way – including a dedicated performance advisor – you will contribute to developing the practice as we continue to invest in accelerating your growth.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Accounting, Finance, or Management Information Systems (MIS)
7+ years of implementation or optimization experience and should have prior experience with architecting ERP solutions on NetSuite.
Leading or supporting full-cycle NetSuite Implementations
Previous experience and ability to gather business requirements and effectively implement an ERP, CRM, & PSA solution
Mastery of Microsoft Office Products.
Consulting experience in other business applications including QuickBooks, Intacct, Salesforce.com, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and/or PeopleSoft is a plus.
Software as a Service (SaaS) or Cloud experience is a plus.
Certified NetSuite ERP consultant is a plus.
Ability to develop, grow and sustain client relationships.
Entrepreneurial spirit and a solution-oriented mindset
Ability to work in ever-changing, dynamic environments.
Ability to craft and deliver verbal, written, and oral messages and make recommendations to a variety of audiences, including client leadership and internal teams.
Desire to get involved in the Riveron culture and internal initiatives, including community service, training, interviewing, intramurals, and other social/networking activities.
Passionate about best practices and the ability to challenge the need for customization and not just using standard native functionality by configuring the platform.

What You'll Do

Execute Projects

Collaborate with Implementation team members to develop effective and scalable NetSuite solutions. Leverage best practices wherever possible.
Work directly with Implementation team members to develop business requirements and translate requirements into specific NetSuite functionality.
Lead client workshops to define implementation strategy to support the growth of the business requirements.
Lead and/or support implementation team(s) in solution design and work with the implementation team to implement the solution.
Work with client IT teams to ensure that the solution design is well understood by the client. Should be comfortable presenting the solution design to the external and internal teams.
Ensure completion of tasks, milestones, and components including but not limited to functional specifications, design specifications, configurations, quality assurance, implementations and project reviews for engagements.

Oversee and lead engagement teams through all phases of a NetSuite ERP implementation or optimization project including business process design, configuration, user acceptance testing, training, cutover and go-live stabilization.

jobs.title: Senior Director Finance
jobs.description:
SinaLite is a leading wholesale trade printer and custom packaging provider, serving 20,000+ print businesses, resellers, and entrepreneurs across Canada and the US. With 26 years of printing experience and over $45 million invested in cutting-edge print technology, we help our clients maximize their print profits — and we're just as invested in helping our own team grow. We were named a 2025 Regional Finalist in Canada's Best Managed Companies Program, and we're looking for our next Senior Director of Finance to help us keep raising the bar.

Compensation: $160,000 - $200,000

Location: 335 Steelcase Rd East, Markham, ON (In Office)

About The Opportunity

SinaLite and Willowpack are looking for a Senior Director of Finance to join our leadership team and take ownership of the financial strategy, discipline, and decision support required to support two growing manufacturing businesses.

This is a hands-on senior leadership role for an experienced finance professional who understands that strong finance leadership goes well beyond reporting the numbers. You will help shape business decisions by bringing greater visibility and discipline to cash, working capital, manufacturing costs, margins, investments, and financial risk.

SinaLite is an established wholesale printing business focused on protecting and expanding margins, while Willowpack is a rapidly growing packaging manufacturer requiring disciplined management of capital, working capital, and costs as it scales.

We're looking for a skeptical, analytical, and commercially minded finance leader who is comfortable challenging assumptions, getting into the details, developing a strong finance team, and giving leadership the financial clarity needed to make better decisions.

For the right individual, this role offers a clear opportunity to grow into a VP-level position within approximately two years.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Cash, Liquidity & Working Capital

Build and own a rolling 13-week cash forecast and longer-term liquidity models.
Develop, measure, and report key working-capital metrics, including DPO, DIO, DSO, and the cash conversion cycle.
Partner with Operations, Sourcing, and the Controller to improve inventory, receivables, and payables performance.
Model the cash and working-capital impact of business growth and changing operating conditions.
Manage banking and lender relationships, credit facilities, and lease obligations.

Manufacturing Costing & Margin Management

Develop and maintain accurate job, product, and SKU-level costing across our manufacturing operations.
Ensure costing accurately reflects materials, labour, yield, scrap, and other production costs.
Partner with Sales to establish pricing guardrails, cost-based pricing floors, and margin expectations.
Provide clear financial reporting that allows leadership to understand the economics and performance of SinaLite and Willowpack independently.

FP&A & Strategic Decision Support

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.
Translate strategic objectives into measurable financial targets and forecasts.
Develop forward-looking, probability-weighted risk and opportunity assessments covering both profitability and cash.
Build financial business cases for capital expenditures, investments, and major strategic decisions.
Track investment performance and returns following implementation.
Provide leadership with scenario modelling and data-driven recommendations to support major business decisions.

Compliance, Controls & Government Funding

Oversee government funding opportunities, including applications, claims, compliance, and reporting.
Ensure compliance with applicable Canadian and U.S. tax, regulatory, and financial reporting requirements.
Strengthen internal financial controls, policies, and procedures appropriate for a growing manufacturing organization.

Finance Team Leadership

Assess the existing finance structure and identify opportunities to strengthen capabilities.
Recruit, coach, and develop finance and FP&A talent.
Ensure team members are positioned effectively across controllership, treasury, and FP&A responsibilities.
Build greater financial accountability across the organization.
Help operational and functional leaders understand the financial impact of their decisions.

Systems, Data & AI

Maximize the value of NetSuite and our broader financial reporting systems.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and financial analysis.
Use AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve the speed and quality of financial insights.
Champion a data-driven approach to decision-making throughout the organization.

Qualifications

CPA designation required.
10+ years of progressive finance experience, including at least 5 years in senior financial leadership within a manufacturing environment.
Strong manufacturing cost accounting experience, including job/product costing, inventory, material yield, and scrap.
Proven experience managing cash and working capital through periods of rapid business growth.
Strong FP&A, forecasting, scenario modelling, and financial modelling capabilities.
Experience evaluating capital expenditures and developing investment business cases.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and lead high-performing finance teams.
Experience working within an entrepreneurial, privately held, or founder-led organization.
Experience within printing, packaging, converting, or a related manufacturing industry is a strong asset.

What We're Looking For

The Right Person For This Role Is Someone Who

Challenges assumptions — You don't accept a number simply because it was presented to you. You validate it, understand it, and speak up when something doesn't make sense.
Gets into the details — You can operate strategically while still being willing to dig into the numbers when necessary.
Thinks ahead — You identify financial risks and opportunities before they become obvious.
Communicates directly — You can translate complex financial information into clear recommendations for leaders across Finance, Operations, Sales, and other functions.
Takes ownership — You approach decisions with a business-owner mentality, high integrity, and accountability for outcomes.
Builds strong teams — You develop talent, raise expectations, and create a finance function capable of supporting continued growth.
Is comfortable challenging leadership — You have the confidence and executive presence to pressure-test assumptions and provide a different perspective when the numbers support it.

Why Join SinaLite & Willowpack?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential finance leadership position across two distinct manufacturing businesses at different stages of growth.

You'll have the opportunity to directly influence how we manage cash, evaluate investments, improve manufacturing margins, scale Willowpack, and make strategic decisions across the organization.

We're also looking for someone who can grow with us. For a high-performing finance leader who demonstrates the ability to operate as a trusted financial partner to the President and leadership team, this role offers a pathway toward VP-level leadership within approximately two years.

If you're a hands-on finance leader who enjoys challenging assumptions, solving complex manufacturing finance problems, building strong teams, and turning financial data into better business decisions, we'd like to hear from you.

Accessibility

SinaLite is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible workplace in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA). We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities.

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please notify us at hr@sinalite.com, and we will work with you to meet your needs in a timely and respectful manner.

Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

jobs.title: Vice President (Head) of Finance
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected, mission-driven organization dedicated to improving well-being and quality of life in the communities it serves. The organization is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Vice President, Finance to join its Executive Leadership Team. Reporting to the CEO, the Vice President will provide enterprise-wide leadership across Finance and corporate services, while serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and senior leadership team.

The organization delivers essential services to a large and diverse client base. Behind every service are countless financial, operational, and strategic decisions that turn resources into meaningful impact. As Vice President, Finance, the successful candidate will ensure the financial strength, insight, and discipline needed to advance the mission and support long-term sustainability.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an accomplished finance executive who combines strategic insight with operational leadership and wants to influence meaningful outcomes in a purpose-driven organization. More than a functional leader, the Vice President will be a key enterprise partner, helping shape strategy, support growth, and position the organization for continued success in a complex operating environment.

The Mandate

The mandate extends well beyond traditional financial stewardship. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the VP will help shape organizational strategy, support evidence-based decision-making, and ensure the long-term sustainability of an organization delivering critical services.

In partnership with the CEO, Board, and senior leadership team, the VP will provide strategic financial leadership across planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, treasury, audit, risk management, and compliance. They will ensure financial resources are aligned with organizational priorities while maintaining the discipline and accountability the mission requires.

A key priority will be supporting the organization through a period of growth and change. Using financial insights and performance data, the VP will help evaluate opportunities, inform strategic initiatives, and optimize the deployment of resources in a complex funding and operating environment. Success will require balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and sound financial management.

Beyond finance, the VP will provide executive oversight of key corporate services, including procurement and facilities, ensuring effective stewardship of organizational resources and infrastructure. The role will also lead efforts to strengthen internal capabilities, foster collaboration across departments, and build a high-performing, engaged team.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to evolve the finance function from a trusted service provider into an even more proactive strategic partner and to enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. Success will be measured not only by financial outcomes, but also by the ability to influence strategy, support growth, and contribute to long-term sustainability and impact.

Leadership and Stewardship

The organization is seeking a VP Finance who leads with maturity and earns trust through action. This is not a role for someone who relies on title or tenure to get things done. The culture here rewards people who show up prepared, communicate clearly, and follow through.
Operates with humility, credibility, and sound judgment
Brings a practical, solutions-oriented mindset
Communicates clearly and influences at all levels
A good partner to the program managers – asking what they need before explaining what the number say
Leads with integrity, accountability, and transparency

Ideal Background

The successful candidate will bring experience in social services, healthcare, the boarder public sector, or the not-for-profit sector. Those who understand the operational, funding, and stakeholder dynamics of publicly funded organizations will be particular well positioned for success.
A CPA designation and progressive senior finance leadership experience.
Experience leading finance within a complex, multi-stakeholder organization.
A strong understanding of financial planning, financial reporting, treasury, governance, risk management, and internal controls.
Experience working with Boards and senior executives in a strategic advisory capacity.
The ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
A collaborative leadership style and a reputation for building strong relationships across an organization.

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to combine executive-level impact with genuine purpose. As a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Vice President, Finance will help shape decisions that influence the organization’s direction, sustainability, and growth.

The successful candidate will join an organization at an exciting point in its journey, with the opportunity to strengthen financial stewardship, support strategic priorities, and help position the organization for continued success. The organization measures its success not only by financial performance, but by the positive impact it has on the people and communities it serves.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of a mission-driven organization, we encourage you to apply in confidence.

new_jobs.title: Vice President of Technology and Data
new_jobs.description:
About the Role

The Vice President, Technology & Data will build the technology and data foundation Equiton needs to operate with greater confidence, efficiency and insight. The VP will assess Equiton’s current systems and capabilities, set a clear direction for improvement, and lead the work to create a more integrated, reliable and well-governed environment.

This is a player-coach role with broad impact across Equiton’s businesses. The VP will modernize core systems, centralize ownership of business applications, build an enterprise data warehouse and reporting capability, and advance practical uses of AI and automation, working with leaders across the organization to prioritize initiatives and deliver measurable results.

***Please note this is an in-office position based in Burlington, ON.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and Priorities

Assess Equiton’s technology environment, including systems, infrastructure, data, vendors, team capabilities and risks, and translate business priorities into a phased technology roadmap.
Define Equiton’s technology architecture and standards, building on our existing Microsoft environment and introducing new platforms where there is a clear business case.
Own the technology budget and build business cases for major investments, setting clear outcomes and tracking delivery, adoption, costs and benefits.

Systems and Delivery

Lead the modernization and integration of Equiton’s enterprise systems, including the transition to HubSpot CRM and the selection and implementation of accounting, property management and construction management platforms.
Guide projects from requirements through testing and launch, improving reliability, performance and adoption.
Take central ownership of all business applications and SaaS: maintain the inventory, approve new purchases, decide what to build, buy, improve or retire, and manage vendors, contracts, licensing, renewals, access and spend, with defined stakeholders and administrators for each application.

Data and AI

Lead the design and development of an enterprise data warehouse that brings Equiton’s core systems together in a reliable source of truth, with clear data ownership and quality standards.
Build reporting and analytics, including Power BI dashboards and self-service reporting, that give leaders timely insight into fund, portfolio, investor and operational performance.
Develop an enterprise approach to AI and automation, leading practical initiatives that improve productivity and decision-making, with appropriate safeguards for data protection, security and human oversight.

Governance and Team Leadership

Serve as Equiton’s senior information security leader, accountable for the cybersecurity program, including security policies, identity and access management, endpoint and vulnerability management, third-party risk, security awareness training and cyber-risk reporting to the CEO and leadership team.
Establish governance for technology, applications, data and vendors that supports applicable Canadian and U.S. requirements, and oversee incident response, disaster recovery and business continuity.
Lead and develop Equiton’s technology team, including internal development, data and reporting, and desktop support.
Partner with leaders across Equiton to understand business needs, drive adoption and deliver practical results.

What You’ll Bring

12+ years of progressive technology experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role setting strategy and leading the modernization of an existing environment, including enterprise system implementations (accounting, property management or construction management platforms especially relevant).
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Management, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
Deep experience with the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Power Platform) is required; experience leading a CRM migration (HubSpot preferred) or with AWS is an asset.
Strong, hands-on data background, including data architecture, warehousing, integrations, governance and BI, and a track record of delivering practical AI and automation initiatives.
Experience leading development, data and analytics teams or external partners, and managing a business application portfolio, vendors and technology spend.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity and IT risk frameworks (such as NIST or CIS), with experience leading security, privacy and business continuity programs.
Experience in a regulated, complex or multi-business environment; real estate, private equity, asset management, multinational or U.S. market experience is an asset.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions in business terms.

About Us

Founded in 2015, Equiton is one of Canada’s fastest-growing private equity firms, helping Canadians build wealth through high-quality real estate investments. Our mission is to make private real estate accessible to more Canadians, and our team is the driving force behind our success.

Follow us on LinkedIn
Visit our Website
Explore #LifeAtEquiton

Why Equiton?

Our culture is built on integrity, accountability, and innovation. We empower our team to take initiative, think independently, and grow personally and professionally. To learn more about our core values, click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. If you need accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We’re happy to help.

Develop forward-looking, probability-weighted risk and opportunity assessments covering both profitability and cash.
Build financial business cases for capital expenditures, investments, and major strategic decisions.
Track investment performance and returns following implementation.
Provide leadership with scenario modelling and data-driven recommendations to support major business decisions.

Compliance, Controls & Government Funding

Oversee government funding opportunities, including applications, claims, compliance, and reporting.
Ensure compliance with applicable Canadian and U.S. tax, regulatory, and financial reporting requirements.
Strengthen internal financial controls, policies, and procedures appropriate for a growing manufacturing organization.

Finance Team Leadership

Assess the existing finance structure and identify opportunities to strengthen capabilities.
Recruit, coach, and develop finance and FP&A talent.
Ensure team members are positioned effectively across controllership, treasury, and FP&A responsibilities.
Build greater financial accountability across the organization.
Help operational and functional leaders understand the financial impact of their decisions.

Systems, Data & AI

Maximize the value of NetSuite and our broader financial reporting systems.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and financial analysis.
Use AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve the speed and quality of financial insights.
Champion a data-driven approach to decision-making throughout the organization.

Qualifications

CPA designation required.
10+ years of progressive finance experience, including at least 5 years in senior financial leadership within a manufacturing environment.
Strong manufacturing cost accounting experience, including job/product costing, inventory, material yield, and scrap.
Proven experience managing cash and working capital through periods of rapid business growth.
Strong FP&A, forecasting, scenario modelling, and financial modelling capabilities.
Experience evaluating capital expenditures and developing investment business cases.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and lead high-performing finance teams.
Experience working within an entrepreneurial, privately held, or founder-led organization.
Experience within printing, packaging, converting, or a related manufacturing industry is a strong asset.

What We're Looking For

The Right Person For This Role Is Someone Who

Challenges assumptions — You don't accept a number simply because it was presented to you. You validate it, understand it, and speak up when something doesn't make sense.
Gets into the details — You can operate strategically while still being willing to dig into the numbers when necessary.
Thinks ahead — You identify financial risks and opportunities before they become obvious.
Communicates directly — You can translate complex financial information into clear recommendations for leaders across Finance, Operations, Sales, and other functions.
Takes ownership — You approach decisions with a business-owner mentality, high integrity, and accountability for outcomes.
Builds strong teams — You develop talent, raise expectations, and create a finance function capable of supporting continued growth.
Is comfortable challenging leadership — You have the confidence and executive presence to pressure-test assumptions and provide a different perspective when the numbers support it.

Why Join SinaLite & Willowpack?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential finance leadership position across two distinct manufacturing businesses at different stages of growth.

You'll have the opportunity to directly influence how we manage cash, evaluate investments, improve manufacturing margins, scale Willowpack, and make strategic decisions across the organization.

We're also looking for someone who can grow with us. For a high-performing finance leader who demonstrates the ability to operate as a trusted financial partner to the President and leadership team, this role offers a pathway toward VP-level leadership within approximately two years.

If you're a hands-on finance leader who enjoys challenging assumptions, solving complex manufacturing finance problems, building strong teams, and turning financial data into better business decisions, we'd like to hear from you.

Accessibility

Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

new_jobs.title: Vice President (Head) of Finance
new_jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected, mission-driven organization dedicated to improving well-being and quality of life in the communities it serves. The organization is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Vice President, Finance to join its Executive Leadership Team. Reporting to the CEO, the Vice President will provide enterprise-wide leadership across Finance and corporate services, while serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and senior leadership team.

The organization delivers essential services to a large and diverse client base. Behind every service are countless financial, operational, and strategic decisions that turn resources into meaningful impact. As Vice President, Finance, the successful candidate will ensure the financial strength, insight, and discipline needed to advance the mission and support long-term sustainability.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an accomplished finance executive who combines strategic insight with operational leadership and wants to influence meaningful outcomes in a purpose-driven organization. More than a functional leader, the Vice President will be a key enterprise partner, helping shape strategy, support growth, and position the organization for continued success in a complex operating environment.

The Mandate

The mandate extends well beyond traditional financial stewardship. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the VP will help shape organizational strategy, support evidence-based decision-making, and ensure the long-term sustainability of an organization delivering critical services.

In partnership with the CEO, Board, and senior leadership team, the VP will provide strategic financial leadership across planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, treasury, audit, risk management, and compliance. They will ensure financial resources are aligned with organizational priorities while maintaining the discipline and accountability the mission requires.

A key priority will be supporting the organization through a period of growth and change. Using financial insights and performance data, the VP will help evaluate opportunities, inform strategic initiatives, and optimize the deployment of resources in a complex funding and operating environment. Success will require balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and sound financial management.

Beyond finance, the VP will provide executive oversight of key corporate services, including procurement and facilities, ensuring effective stewardship of organizational resources and infrastructure. The role will also lead efforts to strengthen internal capabilities, foster collaboration across departments, and build a high-performing, engaged team.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to evolve the finance function from a trusted service provider into an even more proactive strategic partner and to enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. Success will be measured not only by financial outcomes, but also by the ability to influence strategy, support growth, and contribute to long-term sustainability and impact.

Leadership and Stewardship

The organization is seeking a VP Finance who leads with maturity and earns trust through action. This is not a role for someone who relies on title or tenure to get things done. The culture here rewards people who show up prepared, communicate clearly, and follow through.
Operates with humility, credibility, and sound judgment
Brings a practical, solutions-oriented mindset
Communicates clearly and influences at all levels
A good partner to the program managers – asking what they need before explaining what the number say
Leads with integrity, accountability, and transparency

Ideal Background

The successful candidate will bring experience in social services, healthcare, the boarder public sector, or the not-for-profit sector. Those who understand the operational, funding, and stakeholder dynamics of publicly funded organizations will be particular well positioned for success.
A CPA designation and progressive senior finance leadership experience.
Experience leading finance within a complex, multi-stakeholder organization.
A strong understanding of financial planning, financial reporting, treasury, governance, risk management, and internal controls.
Experience working with Boards and senior executives in a strategic advisory capacity.
The ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
A collaborative leadership style and a reputation for building strong relationships across an organization.

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to combine executive-level impact with genuine purpose. As a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Vice President, Finance will help shape decisions that influence the organization’s direction, sustainability, and growth.

The successful candidate will join an organization at an exciting point in its journey, with the opportunity to strengthen financial stewardship, support strategic priorities, and help position the organization for continued success. The organization measures its success not only by financial performance, but by the positive impact it has on the people and communities it serves.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of a mission-driven organization, we encourage you to apply in confidence.
